description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It manages the assignment and removal of keywords for test cases and test suites, providing a web interface for tests and project managers to handle keywords related to testing assets.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and parses input parameters related to keyword assignment operations, including filtering and session data.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI-related state and permissions for the keyword assignment interface based on user rights and current context.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to assign keywords in the current project context.
